name: @hewliyang/xlsx-preview
description: XLSX preview/rendering library for browser, React, and Node.

scripts.build:ts: tsc --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/browser.ts --outfile dist/browser.js --target browser --format iife && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --external skia-canvas && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format esm --external skia-canvas && bun run copy:wasm && bun build src/previewer.ts --outfile dist/previewer.js --target browser --format esm && bun build src/browserLoader.ts --outfile dist/browser-loader.js --target browser --format esm && bun build src/react.ts --outfile dist/react.js --target browser --format esm --external react && bun build src/xlsxWorker.ts --outfile dist/xlsxWorker.js --target browser --format esm
scripts.build:wasm: cd ../.. && wasm-pack build crates/xlcore-wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --profile wasm-size --no-opt
scripts.build:release: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:loc && bun run knip
scripts.dev: bun build src/browser.ts --outfile dist/browser.js --target browser --format iife --watch
